description_en: Queries the details of one or more route map rules
description_zh: 查询一个或多个路由策略规则的详细信息
name: ListRouteMapRules

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a parameter value on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route map to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的路由映射策略ID
parameters.name: route_map_id

parameters.help_en: The list of route map rule IDs to query. This parameter and filter conditions can be used together for matching, and they have an AND relationship
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的路由策略规则ID列表。与过滤条件可以同时匹配查询，是与的关系
parameters.name: route_map_rule_ids

fields.help_en:
The filter condition. Valid values:

Name: the name of the route map rule.
Priority: the priority of the route map rule.

By default, multiple filter conditions have an AND relationship. A match succeeds only when all filter conditions are met.

You can specify up to 5 filter conditions at a time
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件。取值：

Name：路由策略规则的名称。
Priority：路由策略规则的优先级。

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件。

一次最多支持输入 5 个过滤条件
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter condition.

Specify the filter value based on the Key parameter. You can specify multiple filter values for a single key. Multiple filter values have an OR relationship. A match succeeds if any of the filter values is met.

You can specify up to 5 filter values for a single filter condition
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件的值。

根据 Key 指定过滤值。一个 Key 支持指定多个过滤值，多个过滤值之间是或的关系，即只要符合其中一个过滤值，则视为匹配该过滤条件。

一个过滤条件最多支持输入 5 个过滤值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The information about the filter conditions.

You can specify up to 5 filter conditions at a time
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件的信息。

一次最多支持输入 5 个过滤条件
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: sends a check request and does not query the route map rules. Check items include whether required parameters are specified, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request and directly queries the route map rules after the check succeeds
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会查询路由策略规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接查询路由策略规则
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page in a paginated query
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时，每次显示的条目数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or when no next query is available.
If a next query is available, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page in a paginated query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query is available.
If NextToken has a return value, the value indicates the token for the next query

如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

items.description_zh: 路由策略规则的信息

Description.example: Matches production prefixes from on-prem and sets a higher local preference.

MatchConditions.description_en: The match conditions of the route map rule. The system executes the actions defined in SetActions only when a route meets all the match conditions defined in this parameter
MatchConditions.description_zh: 路由策略规则的匹配条件。路由需要满足本参数中定义的全部匹配条件，系统才会执行SetActions中定义的动作

AddressPrefixesInclude.description_en:
The route prefix list for fuzzy matching.

A match succeeds if the route prefix in the match condition contains the route prefix of the matched route.

For example, a policy defined with 10.0.0.0/8 can fuzzy match a route with 10.10.10.0/24.

IP address ranges use the CIDR format. Both IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

This parameter and AddressPrefixesMatch are mutually exclusive and cannot be specified at the same time
AddressPrefixesInclude.description_zh:
路由需模糊匹配的路由前缀列表。

匹配条件中的路由前缀包含被匹配路由的路由前缀即判定为匹配成功。

例如：定义10.0.0.0/8的策略可以模糊匹配到10.10.10.0/24的路由。

IP地址段使用CIDR格式，支持IPv4、IPv6。

本参数与AddressPrefixesMatch互斥，不能同时指定

AddressPrefixesMatch.description_en:
The route prefix list for exact matching.

A match succeeds only when the route prefix in the match condition is exactly the same as the route prefix of the matched route.

For example, a policy defined with 10.0.0.0/8 can only exactly match a route with 10.0.0.0/8.

IP address ranges use the CIDR format. Both IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

This parameter and AddressPrefixesInclude are mutually exclusive and cannot be specified at the same time
AddressPrefixesMatch.description_zh:
路由需精确匹配的路由前缀列表。

匹配条件中的路由前缀必须与被匹配路由的路由前缀一致，才判定为匹配成功。

例如：定义10.0.0.0/8的策略仅可以精确匹配到10.0.0.0/8的路由。

IP地址段使用CIDR格式，支持IPv4、IPv6。

本参数与AddressPrefixesInclude互斥，不能同时指定

AsPathsInclude.description_en:
The list of AS paths for fuzzy matching.

A match succeeds if the AS path in the match condition overlaps with the AS path of the matched route.

This parameter and AsPathsMatch are mutually exclusive and cannot be specified at the same time.

Only AS SEQUENCE is supported. AS SET, AS CONFED SEQUENCE, and AS CONFED SET are not supported. This means only a list of AS numbers is supported, and sets and sub-lists are not supported
AsPathsInclude.description_zh:
路由需模糊匹配的AS Path列表。

匹配条件中的AS Path与被匹配路由的AS Path有重叠即判定为匹配成功。

本参数与AsPathsMatch互斥，不能同时指定。

仅支持AS SEQUENCE，不支持AS SET、AS CONFED SEQUENCE和AS CONFED SET，即只能是AS号列表，不支持集合和子列表

CommunitySetInclude.description_en:
The community set for fuzzy matching.

A match succeeds if the community in the match condition overlaps with the community of the matched route.

Each community is in the format of n:m, where n and m range from 1 to 65535. The community must comply with RFC 1997. Large communities (RFC 8092) are not supported.

This parameter and CommunitySetMatch are mutually exclusive and cannot be specified at the same time.

Incorrect community configurations may prevent routes from being advertised to the on-premises data center
CommunitySetInclude.description_zh:
路由需模糊匹配的Community集合。

匹配条件中的Community与被匹配路由的Community有重叠即判定为匹配成功。

每个Community格式为n:m，n、m的取值范围为1~65535。Community需要符合RFC 1997，不支持Large Community（RFC 8092）。

本参数与CommunitySetMatch互斥，不能同时指定。

Community配置错误可能会导致路由不能发布到本地数据中心

DestinationInstanceIds.description_en:
The list of destination instance IDs to match. The following instance types are supported:

Virtual private cloud (VPC) instance IDs
Virtual border router (VBR) instance IDs

The list of destination instance IDs takes effect only when the direction of the route map is outbound
DestinationInstanceIds.description_zh:
路由需匹配的目的实例ID列表。包含以下类型的实例ID：

边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）实例ID

仅当路由策略的方向为出方向时，目的实例ID列表才会生效

DestinationInstanceIdsReverseMatch.description_en:

false (default): no. A match succeeds when the destination instance ID of the route is in DestinationInstanceIds.N.
true: yes. A match succeeds when the destination instance ID of the route is not in DestinationInstanceIds.N

true：是，即路由传递的目的实例ID不在DestinationInstanceIds.N中时，匹配通过

IPv4: matches only IPv4 routes.
IPv6: matches only IPv6 routes.

You can leave this parameter empty to match routes of all types

RouteTypes.description_en:
The list of route types to match. The following route types are supported:

System: system route, which is automatically generated by the system.
Custom: custom route, which is manually added by a user.
BGP: BGP route, which is propagated through the BGP routable protocol.

You can specify multiple route types
RouteTypes.description_zh:

System：系统路由，由系统自动生成的路由。

Custom：自定义路由，由用户手动添加的路由。

BGP：BGP路由，通过BGP路由协议传播的路由。

支持输入多种路由类型

AsPathReplace.description_en:
The AS path to replace when the regional gateway receives or advertises routes. The original AS path of the route is replaced with the list of AS numbers specified in this parameter.

This parameter and AsPathPrepend are mutually exclusive and cannot be specified at the same time.

CommunityAdd.description_en:
The community set to add to the route.

Each community is in the format of n:m, where n and m range from 1 to 65535. The community must comply with RFC 1997. Large communities (RFC 8092) are not supported.

This parameter and CommunityReplace are mutually exclusive and cannot be specified at the same time.

This parameter specifies the action to execute after a route meets the match conditions.

Incorrect community configurations may prevent routes from being advertised to the on-premises data center
CommunityAdd.description_zh:
要为路由添加的Community集合。

每个Community格式为n:m，n、m的取值范围为1~65535。Community需要符合RFC 1997，不支持Large Community（RFC 8092）。

本参数与CommunityReplace互斥，不能同时指定。

本参数表示路由通过匹配条件后，要执行的操作。

Community配置错误可能会导致路由不能发布到本地数据中心

NextPriority.description_en:
Policy priority of the associated next route map rule.

You can set policy priority of the associated route map rule only when RouteAction is set to Permit. Only the permitted routes continue to match the associated next route map rule.
Policy priority of the associated next route map rule must be lower than policy priority of the current route map rule
NextPriority.description_zh:
关联的下一条路由策略规则的优先级。

仅RouteAction取值为Permit时，才支持设置关联策略优先级，且被允许通过的路由才会继续匹配关联的下一条路由策略规则。
关联的下一条路由策略规则的优先级必须低于当前路由策略规则的优先级

RouteAction.description_en:
The policy action after all conditions are met. Valid values:

Permit: permits the matched routes.
Deny: denies the matched routes
RouteAction.description_zh:
所有条件都匹配后的策略行为。取值：

Permit：允许匹配的路由通过。

Deny：拒绝匹配的路由通过

Status.description_en:
The status of the route map rule. Valid values:

Creating: The rule is being created.
Updating: The rule is being updated.
Active: The rule is available.
Deleting: The rule is being deleted.
Deleted: The rule is deleted
Status.description_zh:
路由策略规则的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。
Updating：更新中。
Active：可用。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除
